get.description: Local read only: saved status/actions, immutable per-generation history and sanitized successor_seed. Actions and seed are advisory, never mutation authority. Saved configuration, runtime health and delivery outcomes remain distinct; samples, outbox and unknown counts use separate units.

post.description:
Swagger 2 cannot express this action-dependent request/response union. The body schema is ONLY a discriminator, not a complete payload: select exactly one complete request and response_data model from x-action-contracts below. Unknown fields and fields from other actions are rejected; there are no per-stage URLs. Every successful response wraps the selected response_data as {success:true,data:...}.
Scope: path id is original G1. Preserve the immutable original envelope and envelope.request.operation_id (root) for reserve/schema/activation; refreshed current CAS belongs in current for schema actions or stage.current for activation-review (then inside the activation envelope), never rebased into the original envelope. The immutable reserve result is not current CAS. A preview's operation_id is used as schema_operation_id for schema-confirm, never as the root; first-start result operation_id is also distinct from root_operation_id.
reserve requires action/envelope/review_digest and records only a reserved draft; required capability checks may probe. schema-preview requires action/envelope/review_digest/current, may perform external read-only probes and save a local token, but never DDL. schema-confirm additionally requires token/digest/schema_operation_id and explicit permission for the stored server plan; inspect returned SchemaOperation.status even on HTTP 200, or 202 while in progress.
activation-review requires action/stage/boundary and is local read only with explicit future B. activation-readiness requires action/activation envelope/review_digest and may inspect the target without DDL or activation. activation-confirm and first-start-confirm both additionally require readiness_digest and recheck scope/CAS/schema/readiness/future B. activation-confirm returns the existing WriteGroupCutover for cutover (valid old v1 may omit activation_kind); first-start-confirm requires first_start and returns WriteGroupSuccessorFirstStartResult, never a fake cutover. The two confirmations are not interchangeable.
operation-status requires only action/workspace_id/lineage_id/original operation_id and path G1, no current CAS or target access. It is a coherent local read of immutable reserve, all related schema operations, cutover and first-start outcomes. A succeeded stage is not runtime running and not SQL committed. On unknown transport/outcome, retain the original request and query status before any permitted exact retry; do not switch intent/root or assume rollback. No general rebase/cancel endpoint exists.

has_default.description:
HasDefault is true when the column fills itself when an insert omits it:
a default, an identity or a generated column. NOT NULL without it cannot be omitted.

aggregation.description: Aggregation is the verified evidence of a mean window: method, counts and coverage, never a value.

committed_at.description: CommittedAt is set only when the destination receipt matched this payload.

delta_known.description: DeltaKnown is set for cumulative records only; false is an unknown difference, never zero.

source_evidence.description: SourceEvidence is the per source result of the applied revision; absent for wide, custom and unapplied groups.

connector_id.description:
ConnectorID and ConnectorRevision are the destination the applied revision froze, which is where every
record below was written. They are never the editable draft's destination.

cleanup.description: Cleanup describes the only rows the operation removes afterwards.

record_ids.description:
RecordIDs lists every exact record the confirmation will write. It is
present for managed-long MySQL test writes; cleanup uses these IDs.

handlers.WriteGroupSuccessorAction.description: Swagger 2 cannot express this action-dependent union. Select exactly one full request from the operation's x-action-contracts; fields from other actions are rejected. Sending only action is invalid.

handlers.WriteGroupSuccessorActivationRe.description: activation-review is local read only after schema preparation, using original stage envelope plus current CAS and an explicit future boundary B. The returned activation_kind selects cutover versus first_start; it grants no activation permission.

handlers.WriteGroupSuccessorConfirmReque.description: schema-confirm requires the preview's token, 64-character digest and schema_operation_id, plus original envelope and current CAS. Only the server-stored plan can execute DDL. Exact confirmation replay keeps its recorded operation. HTTP 200 is a recorded stage result, not necessarily succeeded; HTTP 202 means in progress. Never substitute schema_operation_id for the root operation ID.

handlers.WriteGroupSuccessorCurrentCAS.description: Current CAS is refreshed for a new stage; it never replaces the original immutable envelope or root operation ID. group_id/group_revision name reserved G2, predecessor_revision names path G1. An immutable reserve result is not current CAS.

handlers.WriteGroupSuccessorCutoverConfi.description: activation-confirm requires the unchanged activation envelope, review_digest and readiness_digest; it rechecks future B, scope/CAS, schema and live readiness. activation_kind must be cutover; only a valid legacy v1 envelope may omit it. first_start envelopes are rejected. Success preserves the existing WriteGroupCutover response, not proof of runtime or target writes.

handlers.WriteGroupSuccessorFirstStartCo.description: first-start-confirm requires activation_kind=first_start in the unchanged activation envelope and both digests. It rechecks whole-lineage absence of applied/intake/history evidence, current CAS, schema/readiness and explicit future B. It returns WriteGroupSuccessorFirstStartResult, never an invented predecessor end/cutover/fence. Cutover envelopes are rejected.

handlers.WriteGroupSuccessorPreviewReque.description: schema-preview may perform external read-only target probes and stores a preview token locally; it never executes DDL or activates intake. The returned operation_id is a schema operation ID, not the original root ID.

handlers.WriteGroupSuccessorReadinessReq.description: activation-readiness requires the exact activation-review envelope/digest, including its stage current CAS and future B. It may inspect the target but performs no DDL or activation; readiness_digest is evidence, not a persisted grant.

handlers.WriteGroupSuccessorReserveReque.description: reserve revalidates original envelope scope/CAS and may probe required source/target capabilities. Exact replay returns the immutable original reservation even after head/revisions advance; changed intent under the same root conflicts. It does not run DDL or activate intake.

handlers.WriteGroupSuccessorResponse.description: data is exactly the selected action's response_data schema in x-action-contracts, not an arbitrary combination. A recorded stage success is not runtime running and not SQL committed.

handlers.WriteGroupSuccessorReviewReques.description: All scope and original CAS fields are required. Path id is G1. operation_id is the original root request ID, never a schema operation or first-start result ID. group is a candidate, not authority; boundary is an explicit timestamp, not permission to activate.

handlers.WriteGroupSuccessorStageRequest.description: Return the complete original server envelope and review_digest unchanged, plus separately refreshed current CAS. Path id must match envelope.predecessor_group_id; workspace and lineage remain the original scope.

handlers.WriteGroupSuccessorStatusReques.description: operation-status is a coherent local read with exact workspace_id, lineage_id and original request operation_id; path id is original G1. No current revision, envelope, target probe or token is required or accepted. Schema/first-start result IDs, current head and latest preview cannot replace the root. Response contains all related schema outcomes, not just the latest.

runtime_apply_issues.description: RuntimeApplyIssues carries normalized readiness issues when live apply is deferred or warned.

runtime_apply_message.description: RuntimeApplyMessage 只在 apply_failed 時帶出錯誤說明。

runtime_apply_status.description: RuntimeApplyStatus V2 autosave 成功後的 runtime 套用狀態。

target_data_type.description: TargetDataType 目標資料型態（可空）

rollover_modulus.description:
RolloverModulus and MaxRatePerSecond are the exact, confirmed evidence that
lets a counter's drop be read as one wrap. They are decimal text, never JSON
numbers: a number would pass through a float64 on the way in and lose the
digits this evidence exists to keep. They are independent of the legacy
float MaxRollOver, which is kept as saved and never converted into them.

indexes.description:
Indexes are created with the table and verified against the real catalog.
Absent for legacy wide layouts, so their stored digests stay unchanged.

mysql.description:
MySQL, when set, binds the layout to one backend-resolved MySQL family
and version plus the storage engine and case-exact collation. It is nil
for SQLite and PostgreSQL layouts, so their JSON and digests are unchanged.

partition.description:
Partition, when set, makes the new table an owned TimescaleDB hypertable.
Absent for plain and wide layouts, so their stored digests stay unchanged.

sqlserver.description:
SQLServer, when set, binds the layout to SQL Server specific parameters
including the explicit schema and case-exact collation.

native_monthly.description:
NativeMonthly freezes the initial owned SQL Server partition layout.
Nil preserves the plain SQL Server layout and its existing JSON bytes.

payload_digest.description: Test-write facts. They stay empty for schema operations.

indexes.description:
Indexes bind independently applied MySQL steps. CatalogDigest also binds
SQL Server's inspected object identity so a replacement invalidates confirmation.

partition.description:
Partition shows, and binds into the operation's evidence, the time
partitioning of a timescale table.

sqlserver_partition.description:
SQLServerPartition shows optional native_monthly partition objects and
their initial UTC boundaries.

group_layout.description:
GroupLayout is set only for canonical WriteGroup managed preparation.
Legacy recording-plan previews leave it nil so their digest and storage
format remain compatible with tokens issued before group preparation.

recreate_missing.description:
RecreateMissing is the recovery policy this confirmation shows and
freezes for managed long storage: whether delivery may restore the
confirmed table if the catalog later proves it gone. Nil for layouts that
have no such policy, which keeps their stored digests unchanged.

circuit_id.description:
CircuitID is persisted WriteGroupMember.CircuitID from THIS snapshot, never a column/name.
Missing legacy evidence stays null; adapters normalize absent source identity, not infer it.

source_value_type.description: SourceValueType comes from this persisted member/verified frozen source, never current Tag.

order.description: Order 執行順序 (從小到大)

params.description: Params 轉換參數 (依類型不同)

boundary.description:
Boundary is the exact instant the sources change hands. Zero asks the
review to propose one; apply requires the reviewed value.

cutover_id.description: CutoverID names the forward cutover a rollback reverses.

remaining.description:
Remaining are the sources of the saved draft that keeps recording in the
wide group; it must name exactly the unselected ones.

unselected.description: Unselected are the sources of the applied group that no target takes.

basic_managed_device_id.description: BasicManagedDeviceID is read from the create-once key, never caller-assigned.

layout_version.description:
LayoutVersion is empty for groups saved before layout versions existed;
read it through EffectiveLayoutVersion so absence stays managed_wide_v1.

record_id.description: RecordID is mixed canonical-key scope; persisted only in profile_keys.

recording_profile.description: RecordingProfile is nil for every pre-profile group.

storage_mode.description: StorageMode is set only on managed_long_v1 groups (plain for now).

ownership_fence_revision.description:
OwnershipFenceRevision is an opaque persisted CAS identity. Empty means
legacy/unknown ownership evidence, not permission to accept or close.

cadence.description:
Calculation belongs to this recording member, never to its source.
Absence preserves legacy profiles; mixed submissions must set it.

circuit_id.description:
CircuitID is the opaque workspace-scoped circuit identity. It is never
derived from names or addresses; CircuitName is display text only.

entity_key.description:
EntityKey is the raw legacy group key used only to partition buffered
rows. It is deliberately not interpreted as a destination SQL value.

exact_recording_source.description:
ExactRecordingSource freezes confirmed counter scale, revisions, and
rollover policy for scaled integer long members. Legacy and unscaled
members leave it nil.

source_value_type.description:
SourceValueType records the tag's own data type and ResultValueType the
reduction result type the runtime must write. Both are saved only for a
new recording shape, verified against the real tag, and never change it.

value_role.description:
ValueRole is explicit on new instantaneous recording shapes. Legacy
members and cumulative profiles may omit it; absence never means gauge.

result_shape.description: ResultShape versions mixed result semantics; legacy profiles omit it.

sample_reduction.description:
SampleReduction is empty for every profile saved before reductions
existed; read it through EffectiveSampleReduction so absence stays latest
and a legacy profile never grows the key on the wire.

due_at_column.description: DueAtColumn is mixed-wide dispatch time, never a common member window.

recreate_missing.description:
RecreateMissing is the confirmed recovery policy of managed long storage:
true lets delivery restore the confirmed table when the catalog proves it
is gone. Nil means no policy was ever confirmed and never authorizes
recovery; it is set only on managed long groups.
